messages:
Maya (Eng PM): Heads-up — live captions just dropped for the all-hands stream. We need a quick fallback and a tiny agenda tweak so we can keep the Q&A useful.
Liam (Ops): Seeing the caption service 502s in the stream logs, on it. Moving the Q&A to the end of the deck by ~5m so we have time to fix.
Jay (Platform Eng): Re-routed captions to local ffmpeg-based transcription sink as temporary fallback. Starting recording of the local stream source to S3 bucket redwood-allhands-temp.
Sam (Design): Slide deck: I'll move the audience questions slide to the end and add a note to repeat the question verbally for clarity.
Maya (Eng PM): Thanks — can we also add live clip markers at 00:10:00 and 00:25:00 for easier post-editing if we cut the meeting?
Recorder Bot: Recording started -> s3://redwood-allhands-temp/3325501234/raw/stream-2026-03-23-17-00.ts
Liam (Ops): Temporary captions are rough but readable. Jay, can you dump a short troubleshooting snippet so SRE can revert to the primary caption service once it's healthy?
Jay (Platform Eng): Pasting fallback commands I'm running:
```
# start local transcriber
ffmpeg -i rtmp://local/stream -c copy -f segment -segment_time 600 s3://redwood-allhands-temp/segments/%03d.ts
python transcriber_local.py --input segments --output captions.vtt --model tiny
# push captions to CDN path for player
aws s3 cp captions.vtt s3://redwood-captions/3325501234/ --acl public-read
```
Liam (Ops): Nice. I'll keep monitoring caption-service health and flip the player back when we see stable 200s for 5 consecutive checks.
Ana (CEO): Appreciate the quick pivot. For the Q&A, if captions are flaky, can the host read out the question before answering? Also can we pin the recording and an excerpt link in the channel after we're done?
Maya (Eng PM): Yes to both. Host cue: "Repeat the question for the recording". I'll create a pinned message with the recording link + timecodes after the meeting.
Sam (Design): Also recommend we post a short note in the recording indicating parts where captions were fallback-generated for legal/ASR clarity. I'll draft language.
Jay (Platform Eng): FYI the root cause looks like a routing flap between the caption service and the east-1 transcode cluster — filing a short incident ticket (INC-33255).
Liam (Ops): Queueing incident to postmortem after. For immediate ops: switching player back to primary in 15m if no regression.
Maya (Eng PM): OK team, moving Q&A + open floor to end of agenda (~17:45). Host, please encourage people to use short verbal questions. I'll update the agenda slide now.
Recorder Bot: Clip markers added at 00:10:00, 00:25:00 to s3://redwood-allhands-temp/3325501234/meta.json
Maya (Eng PM): Post-meeting items: 1) Jay to share command log and incident brief, 2) Liam to attach raw fallback segments for QA, 3) Sam to draft caption-disclaimer, 4) I'll publish recording + timecodes in #all-hands.
Ana (CEO): Excellent. Thank you everyone for the fast pivot. :raised_hands:
Liam (Ops): Monitoring steady. If primary caption service recovers we will switch and regenerate a VTT combining both sources for completeness.
Maya (Eng PM): Great — closing this thread and will post final links in ~30m.
